1002.name: Zero-Day Weaver
1002.desc: She lurks in the darkness, spying on and hunting down all security loopholes. The data attack program "Zero-Day" has inherited its creator's signature stability and efficiency.

skill.name: Data Corrosion+
skill.desc: Stun time inflicted by [Trojan] stacks is lengthened.

skill.name: Chain Pollution+
skill.desc: For a certain amount of time after the skill is activated, if an enemy target triggers Data Corrosion, activate [Conduction] on that target.

skill.name: Data Corrosion++
skill.desc: Normal attacks hit an additional enemy unit on the field and apply one stack of [Trojan] to them.

1005.name: Reforged Aegis-Ez4
1005.desc: This highly-modified Aegis-Ez4 is as reliable as ever. Supposedly, the inspiration for its design came from a mecha show where a beam saber was used to heat an onsen.

skill.name: Unyielding Will+
skill.desc: When Pyrolysis is applied to a taunt target, overflow healing from passive skill adds to Shield value from Auto Skill.

skill.name: Aegis Shield+
skill.desc: Gain additional Shield when using Auto Skill. The value of this additional Shield is based on how many stacks of Pyrolysis friendly units have applied during the skill duration. While the skill is active, apply Pyrolysis to enemies using Normal Attacks on self.

skill.name: Aegis Shield++
skill.desc: Targets afflicted with Pyrolysis deal less damage to Croque.

1006.name: Collimating Crystal
1006.desc: It takes the concept of "precision" to its utmost and highlighting it with Fresnel's unique aesthetic sense. Only then it is used to ignite all things.

skill.name: Pulse Laser+
skill.desc: Auto Skill damage becomes Pyrolysis damage that can crit. Applied [Sear] becomes [Pyrolysis] instead and additionally deals an extra stack of Burn.

skill.name: Mirror Warp+
skill.desc: After the passive skill triggers, instantly fill skill gauge and increase self critical damage.

skill.name: Mirror Warp++
skill.desc: When on the field or in a reserve slot, begins transferring energy to all friendly units at the start of battle. When friendly units' Auto Skills deal damage, they apply this transferred energy as additional Derivative Pyrolysis damage. If the target has the Pyrolysis status, this additional damage is increased.

1007.name: Firewalker's Spirit
1007.desc: A blazing soul that burns brighter than the fires around it. The boiling passion gifted to Chelsea might just have left her with a bit too much energy on her hands.

skill.name: High Pressure Cutter+
skill.desc: May use one instance of her ultimate for free per battle and normal attacks apply a stack of [Chill].

skill.name: Super Hydraulic Hose+
skill.desc: Enemies within 2 tiles of self gain the [Soaked] status.

skill.name: High Pressure Cutter++
skill.desc: Normal attacks from allies on enemies suffering from [Flash Freeze] extend the duration of the effect.

1008.name: Lime Elegance
1008.desc: Take some gin, add some sweetened lime juice, and season with the drink maker's bewitching presence; that is how you mix a proper "Gimlet."

skill.name: Cloudtop Mix+
skill.desc: Normal attacks can now target self; normal attacks have a chance to increase self attack speed.

skill.name: Cloudtop Mix++
skill.desc: Normal attack healing multiplier increases, and target receives more healing when below 50% health.

skill.name: Inebriated Gala+
skill.desc: Greatly increases all ally Dolls' ATK.

1009.name: Clear Skies
1009.desc: Designed to look like the balloons that Mai likes so much, its unique structure gives it stability even in the upper atmosphere. Let's go explore the sky!

skill.name: Raging Turbulence+
skill.desc: When on the field or in a reserve slot, summons whirlwinds on the battlefield at regular intervals, dealing avoidable normal attack damage to friendly Dolls and enemy units.

skill.name: Sweeping Storm+
skill.desc: When the Auto Skill is in effect, reduce the Skill Haste of units damaged by tornadoes.

skill.name: Raging Turbulence++
skill.desc: Increase the number of damage instances inflicted by the Passive Skill.

1010.name: Fearless No. 7
1010.desc: The steely, weather-beaten shield in Evelyn's heart, stalwart in the face of any threat.

skill.name: Advancing Tactics+
skill.desc: Damage Reduction increases further as HP decreases.

skill.name: Anti-Riot Measures+
skill.desc: Restore extra health when only 1 enemy is hit.

skill.name: Advancing Tactics++
skill.desc: Inflicts [Lethargy] when unable to knock opponent back.

1011.name: Emerald Abundance
1011.desc: Emerald in colour and prosperous in state, freely displaying life's very vibrance, protecting Souchun in times of danger.

skill.name: Mending of the Verdant+
skill.desc: Passive effect increased, triggers faster, activates when using Auto Skill

skill.name: Malachite Constraint+
skill.desc: Skill Range increased to 2 tiles, healing increased

skill.name: Mending of the Verdant++
skill.desc: Chance to Bind attacker when hit by a Normal Attack

1014.name: Fragrant Gingerbread Men
1014.desc: Sugar, spice, and all things nice. These were the ingredients Choco dumped into the oven. Ding! The kitchen fills with a delicious scent.

skill.name: Choco Energy+
skill.desc: Increase radius of passive healing effect and refill Ultimate bar.

skill.name: Lucky Gingerbread Man+
skill.desc: Enhance Ginger Cookie effect. Targets with Ginger Cookies gain additional Hashrate and grant Choco additional Chocolate Energy when hit. Targets also gain Taunt if they are Guards.

skill.name: Choco Energy++
skill.desc: At the end of battle, refunds a portion of Ultimate bar used.

1016.name: Original Trigger
1016.desc: The lines her trajectory, colours her ammunition, and rebellion her weapon. Her ideals the bullet marks, her freedom the smoking barrel—her words shall saturate the alleys.

skill.name: Ways of the Streets+
skill.desc: When using Auto Skill or when an enemy applied with [Graffiti Mark] misses an attack, gain ATK and Damage Boost

skill.name: Ungoverned Skater+
skill.desc: Makes an additional attack that deals high damage if it only hits one enemy

skill.name: Ways of the Streets++
skill.desc: When an enemy with [Graffiti Mark] applied misses an attack, they are Silenced

1018.name: Sweetheart Aphrodisiac
1018.desc: A sweet temptation that conceals hidden schemes. This intoxicating aphrodisiac was hand-brewed by Florence.

skill.name: Angelic Allure+
skill.desc: Charmed targets gain a Taunt effect when they make normal attacks; if the Charm fails, they take increased damage instead.

skill.name: Special Care+
skill.desc: Applies another instance of weaker healing and applies stacks of Nursing.

skill.name: Angelic Allure++
skill.desc: The first time a friendly unit is at risk of dying, they become briefly immune to all damage instead.

1019.name: Fossil Wings of Enlightenment
1019.desc: The soaring skeleton chases the light in the darkness, releasing Fern from her confusion and guiding her to victory.

skill.name: Dragonbone Awakening+
skill.desc: The Bone Dragon gains more stats. Stats are updated whenever [Solnhofen's Hunt] is cast.

skill.name: Dragonbone Awakening++
skill.desc: Bone Dragon does extra Operand Damage to the target.

skill.name: Dragonbone Awakening+++
skill.desc: Whenever the Bone Dragon does damage to its target, it also does Operand Damage to all enemies within 1 tile of the target.

1021.name: Pulsating Soundwave
1021.desc: Electronic waves, as thunderous as the real deal. Tonight, Groove's revelry opens its doors to all!

skill.name: Dazzling Disco+
skill.desc: [Night Fever] stacks now apply additional effects and increase the entire team's attack speed after an evasion.

skill.name: Carnival Preparations+
skill.desc: Groove's Auto Skill charge acceleration is improved, and the acceleration can be triggered while Auto Skill is active

skill.name: Carnival Preparations++
skill.desc: When allies dodge an attack, the attacker takes more damage.

1022.name: Honed Awakening
1022.desc: Crimson maple leaves fall in the wind, but they are reduced to dust in an instant. Aki sheathes his blade, his form immaculate.

skill.name: Scarlet Moon+
skill.desc: After inflicting a critical hit on a normal attack, the buff effect lingers for a while.

skill.name: Scarlet Moon++
skill.desc: Increases Aki's damage dealt based on the percentage of the target's missing HP.

skill.name: Murasame+
skill.desc: While the skill is in effect, Aki takes less damage and does more damage.

1025.name: Silvered Embroidery
1025.desc: Silvery-white trace, feathered form engraved. Nimble fingers entwined, phoenix now emerging. As if by nature, Chanzhi stitched together a grand tapestry.

skill.name: Opulent Brocade+
skill.desc: [Quilting] time extended, Normal Attack damage increased while active

skill.name: Opulent Brocade++
skill.desc: Gains bonus Attack Speed while [Quilting] is active

skill.name: Floral Adornment
skill.desc: Normal Attacks pierce targets. Enemies transfer [Needlework] to other enemies upon dying

1028.name: Mask of Janus
1028.desc: Is the brand-new face sculpted by her experienced hands superficial hypocrisy, or a reflection of its bearer's inner nature? Only she knows the secret.

skill.name: Agony's Aesthetics+
skill.desc: [Mask of Suffering] is active for longer and can stack damage once. Each additional stack of [Mask of Suffering] deals small amounts of Operand Damage.

skill.name: Souleating Mask+
skill.desc: Normal attacks which deal damage steal small amounts of Hashrate from the current target.

skill.name: Agony's Aesthetics++
skill.desc: When using Auto Skill, deal extra damage to the target if they already have 2 stacks of [Mask of Suffering] on them and apply [Mask of Suffering] to all other enemies.

1029.name: Quick-Snap Camera
1029.desc: It arrives at the scene of the news at top speed, quickly grasps the key points and faithfully records the truth. Willow's trusty camera is also her most important weapon. "Ka-click!"

skill.name: Real-time Report+
skill.desc: Skill radius increases by 1 tile, enemy units within this radius take more damage.

skill.name: Frontline Reporter+
skill.desc: When a friendly Doll teleports, the teleporting Doll's ATK and Hashrate increases while both self and the teleporting Doll's attack speed increase.

skill.name: Frontline Reporter++
skill.desc: Normal attacks have increased chance of inflicting Blind; when normal attacks inflict blind, increase the Physical Damage done by the friendly Doll with the highest ATK and the Operand Damage done by the friendly Doll with the highest Hashrate.

1031.name: Life's Bounty
1031.desc: Death and new life are the founding stones of everything, and they grant Imhotep power over all.

skill.name: Hunter's Wings+
skill.desc: Improves skill damage and heals all allies around target.

skill.name: Beak of Horus+
skill.desc: Normal Attacks ignore a certain amount of the target's DEF and can trigger Critical Hits, while additionally healing another ally with the lowest current HP percentage.

skill.name: Hunter's Wings++
skill.desc: Applies [Spectral Resonance] buff to all allies around the target.

1034.name: Hound Whistle
1034.desc: A whistle for summoning police dogs. Much like a code that activates memories, it clearly elucidates the deep bond between Abigail and Abby.

skill.name: Emergency Drill+
skill.desc: Area of effect increases; allies affected by the aura deal [Derivative] Operand damage to their attackers.

skill.name: Canine Enthusiasm+
skill.desc: Critical hits by allies increase the charge progress of "Canine Enthusiasm"; overflow critical hit rate is converted to increased critical damage at a fixed ratio.

skill.name: Emergency Drill++
skill.desc: Allies affected by either the aura or the Agitation effect increase the charge progress of their Auto Skill when they kill an enemy. Allies who benefit from both get twice the effect.

1036.name: Vector Pyramid
1036.desc: Lam's practicality is reflected in every bit of its design, leading to a conical beam cannon with maximized output, illuminating and igniting everything with the brilliance of a supernova.

skill.name: Focused Disintegrator+
skill.desc: Auto Skill damage is increased. If the target is a ranged unit, damage is further increased.

skill.name: Focused Disintegrator++
skill.desc: Purges all Pyrolysis stacks on the target. Damage is increased for each stack purged. Skill damage is considered Pyrolysis Damage.

skill.name: Fuller's Slide Rule+
skill.desc: When allied Dolls apply Pyrolysis, gain Skill Haste.

1037.name: Seeker's Spyglass
1037.desc: Gazing into the firmament and seeking the mysteries of the stars—For Hubble, this is more than just her job; it is her one and only passion.

skill.name: Grand Starfall+
skill.desc: Damage can score critical hits. Each enemy unit around their target increases damage dealt.

skill.name: Grand Starfall++
skill.desc: Auto Skill additionally triggers a weaker meteor impact on a random unit within the area of effect.

skill.name: Empyrean Alignment+
skill.desc: Gain Ultimate energy when the passive skill triggers. May use one Ultimate Skill as an Active Function per battle (this applies even when on the backline). This Active Function consumes Ultimate energy. Hubble triggers her passive skill after using her Ultimate Skill or Active Function.

1039.name: Azure Blossom
1039.desc: As the cerulean cornflower that symbolizes purity and romance blooms, it ignites a determined light in Centaureissi's eyes.

skill.name: Maid's Discipline+
skill.desc: Applies [Concussion] to the target. [Concussion] causes the target to take additional damage.

skill.name: Maid's Discipline++
skill.desc: Normal Attacks speed up passive skill cooldown when they hit a target afflicted with [Concussion]. Targets with [Concussion] have lowered Debuff Resistance.

skill.name: Maid's Discipline+++
skill.desc: Applying [Concussion] to enemy units grants a shield and boosts self ATK.

1040.name: Whistling Melody
1040.desc: Dushevnaya perks up her fluffy ears as the wind caresses her, and she plays on her flute... It is a brand new melody that levels forests into plains and sweeps the cows into the air.

skill.name: Innocuous Melody+
skill.desc: Friendly buff effects enhanced.

skill.name: Innocuous Melody++
skill.desc: Enemy debuff effects enhanced.

skill.name: Carefree Cavalcade+
skill.desc: While skill is active, friendly units' normal attacks apply a music note on hit. Targets with 5 music notes take additional Operand damage (derivative).

1041.name: Repair Gear - Temp Model β
1041.desc: Having been through countless crises and piecing her path forward with the hopes of the Dolls, De Lacey brings these mechanical lives back from the brink of death.

skill.name: Recovery Substitution+
skill.desc: Gain an additional connection and improve another ally's ATK/Hashrate.

skill.name: Recovery Substitution++
skill.desc: Improve healing effect and heal the connected target with the lowest HP.

skill.name: Destructor Chain+
skill.desc: Further improves linked targets' stats when Auto Skill is active.

1042.name: Timeworn Abyss
1042.desc: With a lance of magma in hand, Hatsuchiri enters the lightless abyss, encrusted with the dust of ages. As sinister sounds of rumbling and movement surround her, she raises her weapon, ready to face this ancient unknown.

skill.name: Nether Plunge+
skill.desc: The damage instance inflicted after emerging from [Prowl] will lower the damaged enemy's Physical DEF; after the first [Prowl], future [Prowls] instead target the enemy unit with the lowest HP.

skill.name: Nether Plunge++
skill.desc: Every teleport made by the team grants Hatsuchiri a point of energy. If Hatsuchiri has not performed a [Prowl] after a certain time, she will expend a point of energy to perform [Prowl]. Each [Prowl] also increases her Auto Skill charge rate.

skill.name: Lacerating Blitz+
skill.desc: There is a chance to increase the damage multiplier of each hit inflicted by [Lacerating Blitz].

1044.name: Unlimited Danmaku Blaster
1044.desc: The keys use mechanical contacts and it comes with LED backlighting and programmable macro keys... Is it a keyboard, or a weapon? The keyboard IS her weapon!

skill.name: Viewer Discretion Advised+
skill.desc: Permanently increases self attack range. When the Auto Skill is used, teleport near a friendly Doll first. Once aiming is complete, there is a chance to increase the multiplier for the additional damage and blind the target.

skill.name: Gun-Key Synchronization+
skill.desc: Once a certain number of [Danmaku] from normal attacks reaches a certain amount, the target will be [Blinded]; Innate skills which hit a [Blinded] target can crit.

skill.name: Gun-Key Synchronization++
skill.desc: [Danmaku] damage is increased.

1046.name: Stringbound Sentiment
1046.desc: The soughing of leaves is accompanied by the sounds of zither strings. Beneath the leaf-shrouded moonlight, Daiyan's notes echo across the sky.

skill.name: Brisk Lament+
skill.desc: Soundwaves from her Passive and Auto skills grant increased ATK and Hashrate to allies which they pass over.

skill.name: Idyllic Resonance+
skill.desc: Concordia status is improved to Concordia+ and is applied to all allies when the skill activates.

skill.name: Idyllic Resonance++
skill.desc: When Dolls with the Concordia+ status inflict skill critical hits, the entire team gains Ultimate Energy.

1048.name: Smoke-Wreathed Talisman
1048.desc: Inspired by the designs on Nora's clothing and decorated with wisps of smoke for a floaty effect... Just like how Nora herself is emitting wisps of smoke as she desperately rushes her manuscripts to make her deadlines.

skill.name: Threefold Ballads+
skill.desc: Every type of debuff on the target additionally increases the damage per instance of damage. Damage can be increased up to 5 times.

skill.name: Remnant Dreamquill+
skill.desc: Every time Mindsurge is obtained, all other allied units have their ATK increased. This increase decays over time.

skill.name: Remnant Dreamquill++
skill.desc: After Nora enters the Wits' End state, she begins gathering inspiration and has a chance to enter the Mindsurge state every few seconds. This chance increases steadily each time Mindsurge is entered.

1050.name: Carving Fantasy
1050.desc: A brand new creation, brimming with fantastical wonders, emerges from the deft touch of Puzzle's sculpting knife. As the essence of the world has been unfurled, now prepare to receive the baptism of art!

skill.name: Mysterious Sculpting+
skill.desc: When a Toad Idol is killed, spawn a Toad Idol on the spot. It is classified as a Doppelganger and only inherits part of the original Toad Idol's HP. When the Toad Idol is resummoned, the Toad Idol Doppelganger is killed (removed from the battlefield).

skill.name: Bizarre Befuddlement+
skill.desc: Increases Toad Idol's Airborne damage and reduces the Bizarre Carvings required for resummoning.

skill.name: Mysterious Sculpting++
skill.desc: Increases the Max HP and DEF the Toad Idol inherits. When the Toad Idol is killed, all enemies within a 1-tile radius are knocked Airborne, taking damage based on the Toad Idol's Max HP, and Stunned after landing.

1051.name: Mysterious Armor - Finale
1051.desc: "The beginning is the end, and the end is the beginning!" Mysterious Warrior Nascita strides the night-time cityscape with a brand new look, declaring war on evil with her Justice Kick!

skill.name: Entrance Speech+
skill.desc: Increase Nascita's Dodge Rate during [Whirlwind] status and when it ends; also gain additional Max HP depending on the amount of [Dissolution] stacks applied.

skill.name: Entrance Speech++
skill.desc: Normal attack damage increases when in [Whirlwind] status and attack speed increases damage dealt. Automatically enter [Whirlwind] status at the start of battle and number of normal attacks needed to enter [Whirlwind] status is reduced.

skill.name: Ascension Drive+
skill.desc: Attack speed increases by the number of [Dissolution] stacks on the target. Gain shields when dealing damage to a shielded enemy.

1054.name: Tastebud Tribunal
1054.desc: A French-style turkey sandwich, easily enjoyable and made with a traditional recipe. That is Millau's professional critique of the dish, so please place your full confidence in her tastebuds.

skill.name: Unveiled Banquet+
skill.desc: When [Fine Cuisine] is generated, grant self the effects of picking it up. When an allied Doll uses their Ultimate, gain damage reduction and a stack of [Flambe].

skill.name: Unveiled Banquet++
skill.desc: Increases the number of starting and maximum [Flambe] stacks. The Shield from [Fine Cuisine] is augmented by the number of [Flambe] stacks.

skill.name: Insatiable Craving+
skill.desc: When on the field, all shielded characters do increased damage and additional Ultimate damage.

1055.name: Staff of Unyielding Will
1055.desc: A staff which reflects Hannah's true nature, combining the mysteries of rationality, wisdom and emotion into one being, while also bathing the world in lambent radiance.

skill.name: Mass-Energy Escalation+
skill.desc: While Crit Rate is increased, allied Dolls gain increased ATK. If a non-ally unit is killed during this duration, further increase ATK.

skill.name: Wide Spectrum Discharge+
skill.desc: Friendly targets which trigger Suppressing Fire gain increased Attack Speed.

skill.name: Wide Spectrum Discharge++
skill.desc: Targets subjected to Suppressing Fire take increased Physical Damage.

1057.name: Cube of Illumination
1057.desc: This cubical gem that contains Turing's will sparkles with a dazzling golden light, shining upon the world with wisdom, truth and will.

skill.name: Task Force Mecha-Hounds+
skill.desc: When a friendly summoned creature dies, Turing will attack the killer (or a random enemy if the killer is a friendly unit) and other friendly summons gain increased attack speed.

skill.name: Reductional Chain+
skill.desc: The skill damage bonus from [Analuein] is further improved and applying [Analuein] causes the target's Auto Skill charge progress to increase.

skill.name: Task Force Mecha-Hounds++
skill.desc: When Turing uses her Auto Skill, the Mecha-Hounds will cause their targets to suffer more damage.

1058.name: Scarred Goggles
1058.desc: This old accessory has accompanied this warrior through battlefields, both real and virtual, and it can easily handle shrapnel from explosions on the cloud. Next step, target locked!

skill.name: Death Blossom+
skill.desc: Bloom causes enemies affected by Operand Corrosion to take additional damage. Bloom additionally applies stacks of Vulnerability to enemies who take damage.

skill.name: Meteoric Nocturne+
skill.desc: The skill procs more quickly; before the skill procs, summon an enemy target in the empty tile closest to the target area. The target is destroyed after taking a Critical Hit and increases Clukay's Critical Damage.

skill.name: Death Blossom++
skill.desc: Increase self Crit Damage when the battle begins. If this unit has the highest Hashrate or ATK on its side, also increase Operand Damage.

1059.name: Slumbering Casket
1059.desc: With a shuttle that weaves threads in one hand and a coffin for souls to sleep eternally in the other, Clotho's hands direct the beginning and ending of lives.

skill.name: Solemn Penumbra+
skill.desc: [Shelter]'s Shield multiplier is increased; Clotho gains a [Rhopalogheist] upon dodging an amount of times.

skill.name: Curtailing of Fate+
skill.desc: Blind the target and increases their damage taken.

skill.name: Solemn Penumbra++
skill.desc: When making a Normal Attack, each [Rhopalogheist] in her possession deals Operand Damage to the target, healing Clotho for a portion of damage dealt; If the target is Blind, increase the damage dealt by this effect.

1060.name: Crow of Scars Retraced
1060.desc: The crow's cry echoes through the dark streets. Dupin's keen eyes and intellect pierce the gray fog of mystery and reach the final conclusion.

skill.name: Discerning the Trail+
skill.desc: Instantly obtain [Notion] at the start of battle. The extra damage from expending [Notion] can crit.

skill.name: Meticulous Inquiry+
skill.desc: When making normal attacks in [Scrutiny] stance, if there are less than a certain number of friendly units around the target, there is a chance to additionally gain [Notion]; if the attack target has [Suspicion] on them, Dupin is guaranteed to gain [Notion]

skill.name: Discerning the Trail++
skill.desc: After obtaining a certain number of [Notion] stacks, additionally gain [Backup Notion]. When making normal attacks, if the number of [Notion] stacks is lower than a certain amount, several stacks of [Backup Notion] will be considered as [Notion] stacks and consumed.

1062.name: Flying Dragon Staff
1062.desc: The spear thrusts straight, and the staff strikes true; with weapon and body as one, I sweep away all before me! The great heroine Jiangyu has arrived; care to spar with me?

skill.name: Impetus' Disciple+
skill.desc: Summons a clone in the enemy's backline at the start of battle. When the clone attacks, the target takes extra Critical Damage.

skill.name: Pursuing Form+
skill.desc: Auto Skill does an extra instance of physical damage which can crit.

skill.name: Impetus' Disciple++
skill.desc: Upon taking lethal damage, negate it and teleport to a nearby empty tile and recover HP while summoning a clone on Jiangyu's former location.

1065.name: Defender's Strongarm
1065.desc: The shackles that once bound me are now a sturdy shield, joined to an icy soul that once fell into darkness. With these mighty arms, I shall crush all nightmares to dust.

skill.name: Medical Peripherals+
skill.desc: Innate Damage decreases the target's Status Resist; damage dealt while immune to death is converted to self-healing when the period ends. While the current target is under a control effect, Innate Skill damage is guaranteed to crit.

skill.name: Therapeutic Diagnosis+
skill.desc: For each enemy hit, the total damage multiplier is increased. The final hit deals greater damage to Resistance Value to all enemies affected.

skill.name: Medical Peripherals++
skill.desc: Gain Ultimate Energy whenever Lind gains [Energy]. After an enemy's Resistance is broken, deal more damage and decrease the target's Physical DEF.

1070.name: Sword of Destined Victory
1070.desc: The radiance of the stars and moon flows down its body. This sword is said to be able to divine the nature of all things, and the shape of destiny is reflected within it.

skill.name: Mirror of Anamnesis+
skill.desc: Damage done by Innate Skills against enemies marked by [Rune of Anamnesis] can inflict critical hits.

skill.name: Mirror of Anamnesis++
skill.desc: Beams prioritize enemies with the lowest HP. Bouncing off Luna herself does not deduct a bounce. Each stack of [Rune of Anamnesis] on a target further increases the damage of [Edge of Prognosis].

skill.name: Edge of Prognosis+
skill.desc: Luna's first Ultimate usage requires less energy

1071.name: Afterglow of the Blazing Heart
1071.desc: A duplex blade that can switch between two modes. Take hold of the radiance that remains, and turn it into a shining edge that severs all doubt.

skill.name: Cumulation – Agitated Fusion+
skill.desc: Implosion can crit. When triggering implosion, additionally trigger a healing effect which can crit.

skill.name: Tunnel – Vector Scatter+
skill.desc: Auto Skill attack count increased.

skill.name: Cumulation – Agitated Fusion++
skill.desc: Increases Pyrolysis damage done by ally units.

1072.name: Starlit Conveyance
1072.desc: I set out upon solar sails, the stars my destination. Voyaging through the universe's trail, fueled by endless imagination.

skill.name: Dauntless Storm+
skill.desc: Cast speed is increased. If the target dies during the Skill, [Firestarter] and Auto Skill charge will be partially refunded.

skill.name: Howling Bolide+
skill.desc: Gain Shield and [Firestarter] at the start of battle. Mech Form's duration is increased. When enemies receive the Pyrolysis effect, their Operand DEF is decreased.

skill.name: Howling Bolide++
skill.desc: Whenever a certain number of [Firestarter] stacks are gained, gain Ultimate Energy.

1074.name: Resplendent Alien Star
1074.desc: Cold, aloof and silent. When the light no longer shines, the quiescent star-corpse floats at the edges of space, awaiting the end of all things.

skill.name: Starhusk Collapse+
skill.desc: The skill's damage multiplier is increased when attacking an enemy whose HP is below a certain threshold; if this damage is enough to kill the target, the excess is applied to enemy units in a 1 tile radius surrounding the target.

skill.name: Supernova's Pulse+
skill.desc: When a black dwarf dies, enemies take increased Operand Damage. When on the field or on the backline, the death of any enemy units increases all units' damage.

skill.name: Starhusk Collapse++
skill.desc: Every sacrificed enemy unit grants all friendly Dolls a Shield.

1061.name: Platinum Ensemble
1061.desc: Beneath the fluttering banner, drumbeats, rhythm and footsteps play a stirring movement together — leave the conducting to Undine. Onward, toward tomorrow!

skill.name: Harmonious Voices+
skill.desc: Plays [Accompaniment]: periodically deals crit-capable [Derived] damage to all enemies. After summons attack a certain number of times, [Variation] is added, shortening the trigger interval of [Accompaniment].

skill.name: Rousing Brilliance+
skill.desc: Each stack of [Variation] increases Auto skill damage by a certain percentage.

skill.name: Harmonious Voices++
skill.desc: When [Accompaniment] triggers, heals the 3 allied units with the lowest HP.
